channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Can Iran’s new supreme leader make peace from behind the scenes?
item.description: Mojtaba Khamenei’s consultations suggest a new system of decision-making is taking shape.

item.title: Police bodycam captures moments before deadly Russian strike in Ukraine
item.description: Bodycam footage released by Ukraine’s National Police shows people rushing into an underground shelter.

item.title: Four people, including a child, killed in Israeli attacks on Gaza
item.description: Gaza officials say more than 1,600 Palestinians have been killed since the so-called 'ceasefire' took effect.

item.title: New Yorkers rally against gun violence after Ghanaian teen’s killing
item.description: New Yorkers marched to demand justice for Ghanaian boy Javits Frimpong, who was shot and killed in the Bronx last month.

item.title: Workers strike across France, hundreds of thousands expected to protest
item.description: Demonstrators are demanding an increase in the minimum wage and higher salaries for all workers, among other reforms.

item.title: Security ⁠officer killed in stabbing attack in Jordan’s capital
item.description: Assailant stabbed a corporal outside the Sri Lankan embassy in Amman, killing him and injuring another officer.

item.title: Iran, Gaza, Ukraine: What will US midterm results mean for these conflicts?
item.description: Despite wins, Democrats lack the two-thirds majority needed to overturn a presidential veto and push through a law.

item.title: Vance walks Trump tightrope with scathing election critique blaming Iran war
item.description: The vice-president's blunt assessment of Republican election defeat marked one of the sharpest breaks with a sitting president in recent memory.

item.title: Pope Leo hosts Bob Dylan at official residence in Rome
item.description: Pope Leo had previously quoted Dylan's work in the preface of a book warning against nuclear rearmament.

item.title: Ukraine says bodycam video shows deadly Russian double-tap bombing
item.description: At least 40 people were killed and another 30 may still be under the rubble after Monday's attack on a Ukrainian village, Kyiv says.
